analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches and source against the canonical definition index and selected T-041 detail. The CI change removes the console routing lane and lint/test/build job (.github/workflows/ci.yml, base lines 37 and 637–658 in the supplied patch). Component Changes removes only its console outputs (base lines 8–9, 22); provider classification and credential-free classifier checkout remain (head lines 19–27). Provider unit/SDK/parity lanes and the fail-closed aggregate gate remain visible at ci.yml head lines 569–591. No supplied change weakens provider signing, qualification, attestation, encryption, cache isolation, native admission, cancellation, or billing controls associated with TB-002/003/007/011, T-041 and T-052–058.
AGENTS.md head lines 5, 43, 49 and 64 and CONTRIBUTING.md patch head lines 19–20 and 55 move console ownership/validation references to the platform; they do not change runtime authorization or assert deployment. Removing console CI alone does not establish a vulnerability in this provider-scoped model, nor prove the console is still deployed from this repository.
Integration should reconcile these removals with the remaining PR's console source/build/hosting retirement and callers of the removed console output, including scripts/ci-component-paths.py and routing configuration. Those implementations and the console retirement are not supplied in this batch; the documentation is not proof of migration. This is an unresolved source-pass integration contract, not a supported finding or a request to audit unrelated platform implementation.
